name: collectobjects
description: collectobjects — for your trinkets (web + Android via Capacitor)

scripts.start: npm run vendor && browser-sync start --server --files "index.html, css/**, js/**, assets/**" --port 8000 --no-open --no-notify --no-ui
scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
